hypotheses.justification: An equivalence preserves limits and zero morphisms, and Abelian C supplies binary products. Thus Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products proves e.functor.Additive without this assumption. After omitting the binder, introduce that derived instance locally and use the original proof unchanged. Neither IsGradedExtInternallyFinite nor Functor.Linear requires this binder to elaborate. The argument also covers trivial categories; empty categories are excluded by the finite products supplied by Abelian C.
